items.heading: Explains how Malchut of Atzilut descended and became Keter in the world of Beria, in ten discussions: — a. In the world of Beria, there is only HGT in the head of AA, and it lacks KHB. b. The Rosh of every Partzuf does not clothe in the one below it. c. Two aspects descend from the screen of the upper world to the lower world: 1) The ten Sefirot of direct light and reflected light that come out of the screen through coupling by striking. 2) The light of Malchut of Malchut of the upper world, which pierces the screen and descends to become Keter in the lower world. d. At first, Malchut was as great as ZA, and she contended, wishing to rule alone, and it was said to her, 'Go and diminish yourself,' to descend to the world of Beria, and there she shall rule. This is the point of Malchut that became Keter in the world of Beria. e. At the time of the diminution, the nine lower Sefirot departed from Malchut and rose to their root in ZA. f. If the nine Sefirot of Malchut depart because of the flaw of the lower ones, then they do not rise to ZA but fall to the shells. g. Just as the point of Malchut of Atzilut descended and became Keter to Beria, so it is in every single world. h. Because of the Malchut of the upper world that becomes Keter to the lower one, the worlds are bound to one another. And the first three of Beria can rise on the Sabbath to the world of Atzilut. i. When the emanated beings are counted in actuality they are only four, namely HB TM, and when their root is counted with them they are five, namely KHB TM. j. And so it is in every single Partzuf and in every single Sefira: the upper one is called Emanator and the lower one emanated, and there is an intermediate aspect between them called Keter, all as stated regarding the worlds. This is the secret of 'I am the first and I am the last,' for Keter is last in the upper one, and it is first in the lower one. — Two aspects descend from the upper world to the lower world: 1) The ten Sefirot of direct light clothed in reflected light, which extend through the screen by coupling by striking. 2) The last aspect of the upper world, which is Malchut of Malchut, which descends and becomes Atik in the lower world. It does not extend through the reflected light in the screen, but pierces the screen and descends.
items.html: *I found, of Rav Gedalia HaLevi, of blessed memory, 1that the first three of the six extremities of AA of Beria, which are HGT, that remained 2revealed without clothing — behold, these three are in the secret of the screen. And the meaning of the matter is this: for behold we have explained, that in each of these three worlds there is one screen for it. And indeed the screen between Atzilut and Beria, when the image of all the lights of Atzilut passed through it, to make against them the ten Sefirot of Beria — behold these, 3did not pierce that screen and pass through it, but only their light passed through it by way of that screen, and all the ten Sefirot of Beria were engraved. And behold, also the first three of AA of Beria, which are HGT, likewise pass through the screen and do not pierce the screen, but are a diminishing light, part of which passes through the screen. But that point of Malchut of Atzilut mentioned above, which descended to clothe in these first three of AA, is the very light itself of Malchut of Atzilut; therefore it breaks and pierces the screen itself, and descends 4and clothes in the first three of AA (of Beria).

items.heading: At first Malchut was as great as ZA, and she contended, namely that she wished to rule alone. Then it was said to her that she should diminish herself from the nine Sefirot of Atzilut, and descend to Beria, and there she would rule. And these nine Sefirot that departed from her joined at their root in ZA. And then she descended and became Atik in Beria.
items.html: And behold, the secret of the matter of this point is that it is known how the two 5luminaries in their Atzilut were created equal to one another in their stature. 6And when the moon contended and was diminished — meaning, that what had been in the secret of a complete Partzuf diminished and stood in the secret of a small point, comprised of ten Sefirot, 7and the other nine points flew away from her, as is known, that her root at first is only a single point, and afterward, through ZA, nine other points were added; for this is why she is called 8a mirror that has nothing of her own — therefore ZA took them back, and she remained in the secret of a small point, and then she could not stand beside him because of her extreme smallness, and then she descended to this place, to the head of Beria.

items.heading: Also after the diminution of Malchut was already rectified, Malchut remained to be Atik in Beria.
items.html: And indeed this was at the time of the diminution of the moon at the creation of the world. But after it was already rectified, and returned to its place back-to-back, and He created Adam HaRishon, and He returned her face-to-face 9as at first — and afterward, through the sin of the lower ones, she returned and was diminished, and descended, for this is the whole secret of our prayer, to rectify her at the time of our prayer, and afterward she returns as at first, for we have no greater power than this. And behold, 10anything of holiness leaves an imprint in its place even though it has departed from there, and this aspect of the point always remained in the head of Beria.

items.heading: At the time when the departure of the nine Sefirot of Malchut is because of the sin of the lower ones, her nine Sefirot do not rise to ZA, but they fall to the shells.
items.html: Indeed, at the time when her diminution is because of the flaw of the lower ones, then the other nine points that depart from her do not return to ZA, to their source, to the place from which they came, but descend, because of our sins, down to the shell, in the secret of the Shechina in exile, and there is no need to elaborate on this.

items.heading: Just as the point of Malchut of Atzilut descended and became Atik in the Keter of Beria, so it was in every single world, that the Malchut of the upper world clothed in the Keter of the lower world below it.
items.html: And let us return to the matter, for this point 20was at first a tail to lions at the end of Atzilut, for 30Eve was a tail to Adam, and afterward she descended and diminished herself into the secret of her point, and became a head to foxes, a head to Beria itself. And so it was in every single world, for the point of Malchut of Yetzira descended into the head of Assiya, and so too that of Beria into the head of Yetzira. And so it was also at the head of Atzilut, in the secret of 'you have made them all in wisdom.' For the light of Ein Sof clothed in the upper Hochma that is above Atzilut, 40and that very Hochma descended and broke the screen over Atzilut, and it descended, its very existence, and clothed in Atzilut, and through it Atzilut receives the light of Ein Sof. This is the secret of 'you have made them all in wisdom,' mentioned regarding the world of Atzilut, as above.

items.heading: Because of the Malchut of the upper one that becomes Keter to the lower one, the worlds are bound to one another, to receive illumination from one another.
items.html: And indeed, all this aspect that was in all the worlds was entirely for the benefit of the worlds, in order to bind one to the other and the other to the one, so that they could receive illumination from one another and from each other, through the end of Atzilut being the very beginning of the Rosh of Beria, and so with the rest of the worlds.

items.heading: Because of the Malchut of Atzilut clothed in the Keter of Beria, which is in the chamber of the Holy of Holies, that chamber can rise to Atzilut on the day of the Sabbath.
items.html: This is the secret of the day of the Sabbath, for then holiness is added in the worlds, and then 50the upper chamber, the Holy of Holies of Beria, returns to rise to Atzilut, and becomes complete Atzilut itself, for the reason mentioned above. And likewise in the rest of the worlds, and there is no need to elaborate.

items.heading: There is no more in any emanated being than four levels, HB TM, and an intermediate aspect between Emanator and emanated, which is Keter, which has in it the aspect of Emanator and the aspect of emanated.
items.html: *The rule that emerges from this is that the truth is that the emanated has only four levels, which are the four letters of the Name [Havaya], and they are Atzilut, Beria, Yetzira, Assiya, and they are Hochma, Bina, Tifferet, and Malchut. For this is why the Torah began with 'Bereishit,' and 'reishit' is nothing but Hochma, as our sages said, 60and they said it in the language of negation, in order to exclude Keter. Indeed, there is an intermediate aspect, comprising two aspects: Emanator and emanated. And this is called Keter, and this Keter has within it the entirety of everything above it, and even though it is the smallest of them all, it nurses from all of them, and it has within it the root of all ten emanated Sefirot, and it bestows upon them all.

items.heading: When we count four, that is the number of the emanated beings in actuality. And when we count five, that is when we count Keter together with them, in which are Emanator and emanated.
items.html: And regarding this, do not wonder if sometimes we say that 70the ten Sefirot divide into four letters of the Name, and sometimes we say that they divide into five Partzufim. For when we say that they are four, that is the actual number of the emanated beings; and when we count five Partzufim, that is when we count the root of the Emanator together with the emanated beings themselves.

items.heading: In all the levels in the worlds, the upper one is counted as Emanator, and the lower one as emanated, in which there are four aspects. And there is an intermediate aspect between them, called Keter, in which is the aspect of Emanator and emanated. And Keter, insofar as it is the Malchut of the upper one, is called 'I'; and insofar as it is Keter to the lower one, is called 'Ein' [nothing]. This is the secret of 'I am the first and I am the last.'
items.html: And know that this is so in all the ten Sefirot in every single world, and likewise in particular in every single Partzuf, for always each and every aspect — the upper one is called Emanator, and the lower one, emanated. 80And the emanated is never less than the four letters of the Name Havaya, even in particular Sefirot and in the most particular of particulars, and there is an intermediate aspect between them, called Keter — and understand this well, for through it all the discourses that we shall explain will be understood. And this is 'I am the first and I am the last,' for Keter is first and it is last, 90and it is 'Ein' [Nothing] and it is 'Ani' [I], for in the aspect of the Malchut of the Emanator that is in it, it is last, and is called 'Ani' [I], which is Malchut. And in the aspect of the root of the emanated beings that is in it, which is the aspect of Keter, it is first, and is called 'Ein' [Nothing], which are the letters of 'Ani' [I].
